name: dedup
summary: The Chapter 10 mirror/clone detector: turns a corpus of crawled pages into clusters of same-operator mirrors and impersonating clones, graded by the dedup scorer.

modules.shingle.py: k-shingles + Jaccard for near-duplicate detection, with a hand-rolled MinHash that estimates Jaccard from a fixed-size signature (scale).
modules.structure.py: DOM-skeleton SimHash — matches a clone by template even after its text is reworded; cannot alone separate a clone from a different service on the same template.
modules.signals.py: Corroborating evidence: shared asset files, key/payment material (reused from the Chapter 9 crawler), and the intent call that separates a mirror (same operator) from a clone (impersonation).
modules.cluster.py: Union-find over the pairwise edges (text near-dup OR template+shared-asset) into per-operator clusters; classifies canonical / mirror / clone. --selftest runs the dedup scorer on its own output, naive vs full.

corpus: corpus/ — the clone lab: a market with an exact mirror, a near-duplicate (banner) mirror, a payment-swapped clone, a reworded keyless clone, a different service on the same template (the false-merge trap), plus an unrelated forum + its mirror and a paste. All watermarked synthetic.

thresholds.note: structure match must be corroborated by a shared asset file to merge, which keeps a different service on the same template out
